name: nba_stats_shots
body:
**NBA Stats (stats.nba.com)** — shot events with location, one row per shot. **30 seasons** (1997–2026) · **94 assets** · 1.1 GB · last asset written **2026-10-01** Upstream source: stats.nba.com official endpoints. > **Season key.** Assets are named with the season's **ENDING** year since the 2026-08-13 re-key (`2025` = 2024-25). `hoopR` and `sportsdataverse-py` still take the STARTING year as their `seasons` argument and translate. > **Note.** stats.nba.com blocks datacenter IPs, so this pipeline runs from a residential connection rather than GitHub-hosted runners. ## Files in this release | Format | Files | Name pattern | |---|---:|---| | `csv` | 30 | `shots_{season}.csv` | | `parquet` | 30 | `shots_{season}.parquet` | | `rds` | 30 | `shots_{season}.rds` | Direct download (no auth, no API key): ``` https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/download/nba_stats_shots/shots_2026.parquet ``` `timestamp.txt` and `package_function.txt` are `piggyback` bookkeeping sidecars written by the R publisher; they record when the release was last refreshed and which function wrote it. ## How to load it | Surface | Call | |---|---| | Python | `from sportsdataverse.nba import load_nba_stats_shots`
`load_nba_stats_shots(seasons=[2025])` | | R | `hoopR::load_nba_stats_shots(seasons = 2025)` | | SQL | `SELECT * FROM nba_stats.shots WHERE season = 2025` in the `sportsdataverse` Postgres warehouse | | HTTP | `GET https://data.sportsdataverse.org/v1/nba_stats/shots?season=2025` (bearer token required) | | Any | `pd.read_parquet("https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/download/nba_stats_shots/...")` — the assets are plain files on a public URL | ## How it is produced 1. **Capture** — [`hoopR-nba-stats-raw`](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-raw): endpoint JSON archived per game / per parameter combination. 2. **Build** — [`hoopR-nba-stats-data`](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data): `python/nba_data_build/` (and the R processor for the legacy tags). 3. **Publish** — `python/nba_data_build/publish.py` uploads the assets to this tag. **The code that writes these files:** - [`python/nba_data_build/publish.py`](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data/blob/main/python/nba_data_build/publish.py)  hoopR-nba-stats-data - [`ops/init/0000_create_hoopr_nba_stats_releases_init.sh`](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data/blob/main/ops/init/0000_create_hoopr_nba_stats_releases_init.sh)  hoopR-nba-stats-data - [`python/nba_data_build/reshape/datasets.py`](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data/blob/main/python/nba_data_build/reshape/datasets.py)  hoopR-nba-stats-data ## Automation **GitHub Actions** — scheduled workflows in the producing repositories: | Repo | Workflow | Name | Schedule (UTC) | Last scheduled run | |---|---|---|---|---| | [`hoopR-nba-stats-data`](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data) | [`annual_nba_stats_draft.yml`](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data/blob/main/.github/workflows/annual_nba_stats_draft.yml) | Annual NBA Draft Update | 08:00 UTC, Jun (days 27)
08:00 UTC, Jun (days 29) | — | | [`hoopR-nba-stats-data`](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data) | [`daily_nba_stats.yml`](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data/blob/main/.github/workflows/daily_nba_stats.yml) | Update NBA Stats Data | 07:00 UTC, Oct (days 18-31)
07:00 UTC, Nov-Dec
07:00 UTC, Jan-Jun
07:00 UTC, Jul (days 1-12) | — | **Orchestrator** — registered in `sdv-orch` as pipeline `nba_stats` (NBA Stats · hoopR), seasons 1997–2026. | Stage | Repo | Script | |---|---|---| | `data.scrape` | `hoopR-nba-stats-data` | `scripts/daily_nba_stats_scraper.sh` | | `impact.backfill` | `hoopR-nba-stats-data` | [`scripts/run_impact_backfill.sh`](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data/blob/main/scripts/run_impact_backfill.sh) | | `data.build_py` | `hoopR-nba-stats-data` | [`scripts/daily_nba_stats_python_processor.sh`](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data/blob/main/scripts/daily_nba_stats_python_processor.sh) | _The Prefect schedule for this pipeline is currently paused; the GitHub Actions workflows above are the live driver._ ## What depends on it - **`sportsdataverse-py`** — [`sportsdataverse.nba.load_nba_stats_shots()`](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-py/blob/main/sportsdataverse/nba) reads this tag directly ([API docs](https://py.sportsdataverse.org/)). - **`hoopR`** — [`hoopR::load_nba_stats_shots()`](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR/blob/main/R/load_nba_stats.R) reads this tag directly. - **`sdv-db`** — registered in the sdv-db catalog and ingested into the `sportsdataverse` Postgres warehouse as `nba_stats.shots`, and served by the Data API at `/v1/nba_stats/shots`. -
